payload.title: Document the public knowledge base on the Papyrus marketing site
payload.description:
Standing rule: each initiative gets a documentation story on the Papyrus marketing site when its features are live. Document the knowledge snapshot command, public wiki pages, components and how to adopt them. Conventions: PPY-ab79ea, PPY-228e8d.

```gherkin
Feature: Marketing site documentation
  Scenario: Features documented
    Given the public knowledge base features are live on a pilot site
    Then the Papyrus marketing site describes setup, the snapshot command and the components
```
